name: Kotlin

requires.installHint: Install a JDK 17 or newer, e.g. Temurin from https://adoptium.net. Android Studio's bundled JDK works when JAVA_HOME points to it.

ide: Open the folder in IntelliJ IDEA or Android Studio.
runnerHint: Install a JDK 17 or newer, e.g. Temurin from https://adoptium.net. Android Studio's bundled JDK works when JAVA_HOME points to it.

levelHints.Beginner: new to Kotlin: null safety, data classes, collections.
levelHints.Intermediate: comfortable day to day: sealed classes and `when`, extension and scope functions, lambdas.
levelHints.Advanced: design trade-offs: coroutines, Flow, generics and variance, delegation.
levelHints.Expert: deep language and runtime topics: structured concurrency edge cases, inline and reified, DSL builders.
